description.p: Presets for Easy Effects: output presets (105) and microphone presets (2), plus the impulse responses and HRTF datasets they use. Bundled assets have mixed licenses; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in the repository.

ul.li: Headphone virtualization with the Convolver (HeSuVi-derived, EFOtech MLV, synthetic crossfeed and binaural room, MIT KEMAR, ARI, IRCAM LISTEN, TH Köln KU100 and FABIAN HRTFs, a WDR control-room BRIR, and synthesized-renderer kernels: FLORA, ORCHARD, AQUILA, DELTA, LibreAtmos, LibreHolo, LibreSpatial, LibreDecibel, RICE)
Utility and effects (night listening, loudness leveling, mono sum, reference transparency, and others)
Microphone noise suppression and voice broadcast

description.p: Adds a measured HRTF/BRIR pack: true-stereo kernels built from the TH Köln KU100 and TU Berlin FABIAN HRTFs and a KU100 recording of WDR Control Room 1.
Adds 34 synthesized-renderer presets and two microphone presets, level-matches the convolver presets, fixes limiter values, and introduces the manifest-driven installer and the preset validator.
FLORA Cinema and Music use dedicated true-stereo kernels in a convolver and limiter chain; the full-marker variants are removed.
Adds Reference Transparency: 18 Hz high-pass, ISO 226:2023 loudness compensation, true-peak-safe limiter.
Disables autogain and fixes limiter output gain across the FLORA presets to prevent level drift.
Adds the FLORA preset pack built on two self-authored true-stereo kernels.
Initial tagged release: 67 presets and 55 impulse-response/HRTF kernels.
